title: Google places & radius search
body: Would be great to include google places lookup with a mile radius option when using geo search with a google map that adjusts when searching different cities for example (and within say 100 miles of a particular city)

comments.body:
Hi @spindriftwebs thanks for the issue, could you detail a bit more what you want to achieve UX wise and how instantsearch.js is lacking features to do so nowadays?

Please ask your question on discourse: https://discourse.algolia.com/c/instantsearch

Thanks!
